headline: Kasapreko Posts GH¢296 Million Nine-Month Profit, Up 14.3%
summary: Ghanaian beverage manufacturer Kasapreko reported a profit after tax of GH¢296 million for the nine months ended September 2026, representing a 14.3% increase year-on-year.
why: Quarterly earnings reports provide baseline financial health indicators for publicly listed consumer goods manufacturers.

impacts.name: Kasapreko PLC
impacts.why: Higher net profit after tax reflects stronger sales margins and operational profitability.
